title: Define deterministic resource-budget and quota contracts
businessObjective: Prevent AI and Staff workloads from exhausting capacity or affecting booking operations.
technicalObjective: Implement the finite static V1 resource-budget policy, structural authority, private-authority classifier, exact validator, and bounded documentation fixed by GOV-053; do not connect to a provider meter or implement resource control.
assumptions: The committed policy fixes dimensions, thresholds, states, ceilings, mappings, and precedence; declared usage and limits are untrusted observation metadata, not live provider facts.
P2-007 is static Tier-0 classification only and cannot meter, reserve, throttle, pause, requeue, block, schedule, notify, execute, write, or affect booking.
GOV-054 must be terminal before activation so the exact validator can run through independent machine verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Create only `schemas/resource-budget-contract-v1.schema.json`, `policies/resource-budget-policy-v1.json`, `packages/resource-governance-contracts/src/resource-budget-contract-v1.mjs`, `tests/resource-governance/validate-resource-budget-contract-v1.mjs`, bounded P2-007 documentation, evidence, and lifecycle state.

The closed V1 policy implements exactly eleven resource dimensions, their units, 5000/7500/9000/10000 basis-point thresholds, six budget states, seven meter states, five budget-authority states, five configuration states, two internal workload zones, six non-authoritative outcomes, workload ceilings, booking isolation, decision rules, reason precedence, and false authority claims from the GOV-053 design.

The runtime-safe deep module exports only `evaluateResourceBudget(observation)`, obtains canonical schema/policy authority internally, accepts no injected authority or infrastructure, returns recursively frozen plain data, does not mutate input, and never throws for malformed, cyclic, throwing, or adversarial input.

Only available budget authority, valid configuration, fresh bounded metering, complete safe-integer measurements, valid workload controls, and isolated Staff/AI zones reach deterministic integer threshold classification; all missing, unavailable, stale, inconsistent, uncertain, unknown, unsupported, malformed, shared-booking, or unbounded cases fail closed with ordered finite reasons.

Threshold mapping is exact: below 50 continue candidate, 50 warning candidate, 75 throttle candidate, 90 pause or safe-requeue candidate, and at/over hard limit block candidate; every result remains non-authoritative and authorizes no scheduling, execution, notification, production write, or booking effect.

Workload semantics require bounded batching, deduplication, idempotency, backpressure, rate/concurrency/retry ceilings, retry-attempt bounds, dead-letter handling, priority queues, and scheduled-summary or governed-case operation; per-interaction work, continuous/per-event summaries, and per-event AI are rejected.

The exact validator compiles Draft 2020-12 authorities, validates result exclusivity, covers every dimension/state/outcome/threshold edge, real exploit paths, booking isolation, workload mutations, authority injection, malformed totality, private imports, and operational non-authority; all packet-authorized checks and independent Sol QA pass.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P2-007 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: schema and canonical-policy finite authority inspection
threshold, metering uncertainty, workload ceiling, and booking isolation review
total fail-closed mutation and negative matrix
solEscalationTriggers: Any provider/live meter, account quota, clock, service, queue, workflow, scheduler, notifier, booking capacity, production control, generic validator admission, or scope outside the finite static GOV-053 design requires a separate approved packet.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only P2-007 static schema, policy, module, validator, documentation, lifecycle state, and task-specific evidence; preserve GOV-053/GOV-054 evidence, terminal records, canonical sources, immutable snapshots, and all external systems.
